verdict.rationale: The public guidance pages on corp.delaware.gov (howtoform, paytaxes, frtax, fee, homepage) were captured as readable text, which implies server-rendered pages a keyless agent can fetch. The probes received ordinary HTTP 404 responses rather than a bot wall. The only documented image CAPTCHA sits on the icis franchise-tax filing entry page, which is a transactional surface rather than the published guidance surface, but it is the nearest gate to the reading surface. Missing for 10: an explicit probe confirming HTTP 200 for guidance pages with an identified user agent, a documented crawl policy (robots.txt) for corp.delaware.gov, and explicit confirmation that the pages are not JS-only shells.
